speech_elevator_keycard: My keycard is toast. Literally. Guess I'm taking the scenic route... through my own traps.
quips_random: Without my exoskeleton I'd never have survived that jump.
Good thing I reinforced my bones with titanium.
The cloning station was my best idea. Well, second best. Right after the pizza teleporter. Which never worked.
Note to self: sentry guns don't recognize faces. Only keycards.
My anti-gravity boots would be handy right now. They're upstairs. Next to the front door.
These X-ray goggles would really help here. Where did I put them?
My coffee accelerator started out like this, too.
Who designed these traps? Oh. Right. Me.
Mental note: install fewer death lasers.
Time is relative. Cold pizza is not.
If that pizza gets cold, I'm suing myself.
Safety first. Second. Somewhere on the list, anyway.
quips_respawn: Number {n}. Memories intact. Dignity... less so.
Clone #{n}. The last one had it coming.
